name: workflows
description: List or inspect reusable prompt workflows stored as markdown files in workflows/ (and .cursor/workflows). Input: {} to list, {"name":"plan"} to show one, {"name":"plan","args":"feature"} to expand it into the full prompt. The agent should use this to discover repeatable task templates instead of improvising.

name.description: Workflow name (file stem of workflows/<name>.md). Omit to list all.

args.description: Arguments to substitute for {{args}} / $ARGUMENTS in the workflow body.
